entitySuffixRule: Must contain the words "limited liability company" or the abbreviations "L.L.C.," "LLC," "L.C.," or "LC" (§ 1-502). A benefit LLC adds the word "Benefit."
distinguishabilityNote: Must be distinguishable upon the records of the State Department of Assessments and Taxation from the entity name of any entity organized or authorized to transact business in the State, from any entity name reserved or registered under Title 1, Subtitle 5, and from the disclosed assumed name adopted by a foreign entity authorized to transact business in this State (§ 1-504). Section 1-504 states no consent route: unlike most states, it does not provide for using a name that is not distinguishable with the written consent of the other holder.
nameReservationCostBasis: The SDAT fee to reserve a name is $25.
notes: Maryland is not a Secretary of State state: LLCs are formed, named, and searched at the State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT). The LLC name section (§ 4A-208) points to the general naming rules in Title 1, Subtitle 5, so the designator (§ 1-502(b)) and the distinguishability test on Department records (§ 1-504) are the same for every Maryland entity. Section 1-503, despite sitting between them, is a purpose-and-designator restriction rather than the distinguishability rule. A reservation lasts only 30 days (§ 1-505), one of the shortest holds in the country. Maryland LLCs file an annual report carrying a flat $300 fee (the state's business personal-property return), due April 15.
